payload.name: Capsule CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chat with your Capsule CRM directly in ChatGPT and Codex. Ask who you should follow up with, find contacts, review your pipeline, prep for meetings, or get quick reports on what matters most - in plain, everyday language.

You can also ask to update custom fields on contacts, opportunities and projects. ChatGPT and Codex use your live Capsule data and respects your existing permissions.

Available on Growth plan and above.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中直接与 Capsule CRM 对话。用日常语言询问应该跟进谁、查找联系人、查看销售渠道、准备会议，或快速获取重要事项的报告。

你还可以请求更新联系人、商机和项目中的自定义字段。ChatGPT 和 Codex 会使用你的 Capsule 实时数据，并遵循你现有的权限。

Growth 及以上套餐可用。

payload.name: Superlist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Superlist helps users manage personal and shared tasks and lists from ChatGPT, including finding work, creating tasks and lists, updating due dates and notes, completing or deleting items, assigning work, and sharing lists with existing collaborators.
payload.longDescription: Superlist 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理个人和共享的任务及清单，包括查找工作内容、创建任务和清单、更新截止日期和备注、完成或删除项目、分配工作，以及与现有协作者共享清单。

payload.name: lolcv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your lolcv account to find and read your CVs and cover letters, prepare tailored drafts from content you approve, and search job listings with source links. Choose from 98 CV templates, including 32 Pro designs, or 13 cover-letter designs. Restyle a CV into a separate copy while keeping the original. Pro identifies a design collection; all listed templates are currently selectable. Job filters may be sent to external providers; results may be cached or incomplete. Separate permissions control CVs, cover letters and job search. Open drafts in lolcv to review the layout, edit and export. Requires a lolcv account. Does not send applications, contact employers, publish, overwrite or delete documents.
payload.longDescription: 连接 lolcv 账户，查找并阅读你的简历和求职信，根据你批准的内容准备定制草稿，并通过来源链接搜索职位列表。可从 98 款简历模板（含 32 款 Pro 设计）或 13 款求职信设计中选择。重新设计简历时会另存为副本，保留原件。Pro 表示某个设计系列；目前列出的所有模板都可以选择。职位筛选条件可能会发送给外部服务提供商；搜索结果可能经过缓存或不完整。简历、求职信和职位搜索分别由不同权限控制。你可以在 lolcv 中打开草稿，检查版式、编辑并导出。需要 lolcv 账户。本应用不会代你投递申请、联系雇主、发布内容、覆盖或删除文档。

payload.name: Fellow.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access and act on your meeting knowledge instantly. Fellow connects ChatGPT to your meeting ecosystem, letting you search transcripts, pull key insights from summaries, and track action items with natural-language queries. You can also add talking points, notes, and follow-ups straight to your meeting agendas, so you walk into every meeting prepared.

Need to recall decisions from last quarter? Looking for action items assigned to your team? Want to reference that brilliant idea from yesterday's brainstorm, or add it to next week's agenda? Simply ask ChatGPT and skip the endless scrolling through notes.

Get the clarity you need, exactly when you need it, with Fellow's secure, centralized meeting intelligence.
payload.longDescription:
Fellow 可即时访问并运用你的会议知识。它将 ChatGPT 连接到你的会议环境，让你通过自然语言查询搜索转录文本、提取摘要中的关键信息并跟踪行动事项。你还可以直接向会议议程添加讨论要点、笔记和后续事项，让自己每次开会都准备充分。

需要回忆上季度的决策？想查找分配给团队的行动事项？想引用昨天头脑风暴中的精彩想法，或将其加入下周议程？只需询问 ChatGPT，无需再没完没了地翻阅笔记。

借助 Fellow 安全、集中的会议智能，在需要时获得清晰的信息。

payload.name: Hubstaff
payload.description: 面向 AI 的员工队伍洞察
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Hubstaff MCP server enables AI tools to understand and work with workforce data in real time. Analyze productivity trends, identify workload imbalances, surface operational insights, and interact with Hubstaff data through natural language and agent workflows.
payload.longDescription: Hubstaff MCP 服务器让 AI 工具能够实时理解并处理员工队伍数据。分析效率趋势、发现工作负荷失衡、提取运营洞察，并通过自然语言和智能体工作流与 Hubstaff 数据交互。

payload.name: TimePeace — Daily Log
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TimePeace is one calm, private place for your whole life — diary, journal, habits, mood, meals, exercise, money, people and travel. Connect the AI assistant you already use, and it can help you plan and keep that life, in plain language.

Ask it to turn a booking confirmation into a trip — flights, hotel and dates filled in — to build a week of training, or to plan your meals and add what you need to your shopping list. It can also log your day as you talk: a workout, a meal, an appointment, a note. Everything it adds is labelled as coming from your assistant, and it can remove only what it added — never your own entries.

You decide what it can touch. Adding to your diary is the baseline; reading your days back, and changing the things you've made (your trips, routines and meal plans), are each a separate permission you grant when you connect — never bundled, and health, people and money each need their own permission on top. Leave a permission off and those tools simply, honestly decline.

Nothing is sold, shared for advertising, or used to build a profile — no third-party trackers, no ads. It's your diary; the assistant is just another way in, working only where you let it.
payload.longDescription:
TimePeace是你整个生活的平静私密空间——日记、日志、习惯、情绪、饮食、运动、金钱、人际关系和旅行。连接你已有的AI助手，它就能用通俗易懂的语言帮你规划并维持这种生活。

让它把预订确认信息转化为旅行计划——自动填充航班、酒店和日期——来安排一周的训练，或规划你的饮食并把所需物品添加到购物清单。它还能在你说话时记录当天的活动：一次锻炼、一餐饭、一次约会或一条备忘录。它添加的每项内容都会标注为来自你的助手，且只能删除自己添加的内容——绝不会影响你的原始记录。

你决定它能操作哪些内容。添加日记是基础权限；回顾查看日期、修改已创建的内容（你的行程、日常安排和饮食计划）则需要分别授权——这些权限在连接时单独授予，不会捆绑在一起。健康、人际关系和金钱相关功能还需额外单独授权。如果未开启某项权限，对应的功能会直接且诚实地拒绝请求。

所有内容都不会被出售、用于广告共享或用于构建用户画像——没有第三方追踪器，也没有广告。这是你的日记，助手只是另一种访问方式，仅在你允许的范围内工作。

payload.name: Glance
payload.description: 将小部件连接至任意内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Glance puts widgets on the iPhone Home Screen and lets you update them from this chat. Create a widget, design its layout, and push whatever you want onto it. Pinning happens on the iPhone.
payload.longDescription: Glance将小部件放置在iPhone主屏幕上，并通过此聊天界面进行更新。创建小部件、设计布局，并推送您想要的任何内容至其上。固定操作在iPhone上进行。

payload.name: Addness
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Addness helps teams and AI agents work from the same goal tree. Use it to read current goals, comments, deliverables, and activity, then turn plans into concrete subgoals, update progress, and keep execution context in one shared workspace.
payload.longDescription: Addness帮助团队和AI代理从同一目标树协作。可通过该工具查看当前目标、评论、交付成果和活动，然后将计划转化为具体子目标，更新进度，并在共享工作区中保持执行上下文。

payload.name: SuperIntern
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SuperIntern lets users securely access the meetings and projects available to them in their selected workspace, including meeting metadata, transcripts, live transcripts, AI summaries, and notes. The connector is read-only and follows each user's existing SuperIntern permissions through OAuth.
payload.longDescription: SuperIntern允许用户安全访问其选定工作区中的会议及项目数据，包括会议元数据、转录文本、实时转录、AI摘要和笔记。该连接器为只读模式，并通过OAuth协议遵循用户的现有SuperIntern权限。

payload.name: Project Plan 365
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Project Plan 365 lets you work with Microsoft Project (MS Project) and MPP files directly in ChatGPT. Create and manage project plans and Gantt chart schedules, open and analyze existing Microsoft Project MPP files, and review tasks, milestones, dates, durations, resources, assignments, dependencies, progress, and critical paths. Update project schedules using natural language, then download the updated MPP file or open it in Project Plan 365. Simplify project planning and project management while keeping your plans compatible with the Microsoft Project MPP file format.
payload.longDescription: Project Plan 365允许您在ChatGPT中直接处理Microsoft Project（MS Project）和MPP文件。创建和管理项目计划及甘特图进度计划，打开并分析现有Microsoft Project MPP文件，查看任务、里程碑、日期、持续时间、资源、分配、依赖关系、进度和关键路径。通过自然语言更新项目计划，然后下载更新后的MPP文件或在Project Plan 365中打开。在简化项目规划和管理的同时，确保您的计划与Microsoft Project MPP文件格式兼容。

payload.name: PostPlanify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PostPlanify brings social media management into ChatGPT.

Create, schedule, publish, and manage social media content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Google Business Profile, and Bluesky.

Manage your full social media workflow from one place, including content planning, publishing calendars, social media analytics, performance reports, social inbox conversations, comments and messages, client workspaces, team collaboration, approvals, and account management.

PostPlanify is built for social media managers, marketing teams, agencies, and businesses managing multiple brands or client accounts. Use it to plan campaigns, review performance, generate reports, manage audience engagement, organize client work, and handle day-to-day social media operations directly from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
PostPlanify将社交媒体管理融入ChatGPT

在Instagram、Facebook、LinkedIn、X、TikTok、YouTube、Threads、Pinterest、谷歌商业资料和Bluesky等平台创建、安排、发布和管理社交媒体内容

从一个平台管理完整的社交媒体工作流程，包括内容策划、发布日历、社交媒体分析、绩效报告、社交收件箱对话、评论和消息、客户工作区、团队协作、审批流程和账户管理

PostPlanify专为社交媒体经理、营销团队、代理机构和管理多个品牌或客户账户的企业设计，可通过ChatGPT直接规划活动、查看绩效、生成报告、管理受众互动、整理客户工作并处理日常社交媒体运营

payload.name: Browser
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read browser tabs in Chat mode or control your connected browser in Work mode.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天模式下浏览浏览器标签页，或在工作模式下控制已连接的浏览器。

payload.name: Ragic
payload.description: 与你的无代码数据库对话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ragic plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your Ragic databases, including comments and email threads tied to any record. Once connected, ChatGPT can analyze trends, flag what needs follow-up, and help you think through next steps using your real business data.

Ragic is a no-code AI platform for building custom database systems — CRM, inventory, project tracking, and more.
payload.longDescription:
Ragic插件可为ChatGPT提供对Ragic数据库的只读访问权限，包括任何记录相关的评论和邮件对话。连接成功后，ChatGPT可利用真实业务数据分析趋势、标记需要跟进的内容，并帮助你制定下一步行动方案。

Ragic是一个无代码AI平台，可用于构建自定义数据库系统——包括客户关系管理（CRM）、库存管理、项目追踪等。

payload.name: Lara Translate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lara Translate brings professional-grade, context-aware translation directly into OpenAI.

Use Lara to translate text between supported languages, detect source languages, and work with translation memories and glossaries from your Lara Translate account. The app supports translation styles, contextual instructions, terminology control, adaptive memories, privacy options, HTML and XLIFF content, and Lara Think reasoning for higher-quality translation decisions.

It is designed for users and teams who need reliable multilingual output, consistent terminology, reusable translation assets, and translation workflows that can be automated from inside OpenAI.
payload.longDescription:
Lara Translate 将专业级的上下文感知翻译直接引入 OpenAI。

使用 Lara 进行跨支持语言的文本翻译，检测源语言，并使用来自 Lara Translate 账户的翻译记忆库和术语表。该应用支持翻译风格、上下文指令、术语控制、自适应记忆库、隐私选项、HTML 和 XLIFF 内容，以及 Lara Think 推理以实现更高质量的翻译决策。

该工具专为需要可靠多语言输出、一致术语、可重复使用的翻译资源，以及可在 OpenAI 内部自动化的翻译工作流的用户和团队设计。

payload.name: There's An AI For That
payload.summaryOriginal: Find AI tools for any task
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: There's An AI For That helps users search a public directory of AI tools, filter and rank matches, and inspect detailed tool information and links.
payload.longDescription: 凡事皆有AI帮助用户搜索公共目录中的AI工具，筛选和排序匹配结果，并查看详细的工具信息和相关链接。

payload.name: DomainWisp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate brandable business-name ideas in ChatGPT, then verify live domain availability across popular extensions. DomainWisp returns registry check times, registration and renewal prices, premium status, registrar, and source so you can compare realistic options before choosing a name.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中生成可注册的品牌名称创意，然后验证热门域名后缀的实时可用性。DomainWisp会提供注册局检查时间、注册和续费价格、溢价状态、注册商及数据源，让您在选择名称前对比真实可选方案。

payload.name: ReverseGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReverseGPT humanizes AI-generated text so it reads naturally while preserving meaning, facts, and formatting. It supports up to 1,000 words per call, optional Ultra processing for eligible plans, and free polling for unfinished jobs. Credit-based plans use one ReverseGPT credit per input word. Max includes humanization without deducting credits. Credits deducted for failed runs are refunded.
payload.longDescription: ReverseGPT能将AI生成的文本转化为自然流畅的表达，同时保留原意、事实和格式。该工具每轮处理最多1000个字，符合条件的计划可选超精度处理模式，未完成任务可享受免费轮询服务。按信用计费的计划每输入一个字消耗一个ReverseGPT信用点，高级版可实现人性化处理且不扣减信用点，失败运行扣除的信用点将被全额退还。

payload.name: Codelit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn an idea into a focused Product Plan, practical System Architecture, and supervised Agent Team. Define first-release scope, user journeys, components, data flows, tool permissions, handoffs, approval gates, and tests. Connect reviewed work into an implementation plan or a scoped Codex handoff.

Five planning skills are complemented by a public, read-only MCP server that lists four Codelit workflows and retrieves bundled Markdown planning templates with canonical collection links. No sign-in is required. The server does not access Codelit accounts, accept private drafts, save content, run independent agents, or deploy software. Templates are bundled reference material, not live account data.
payload.longDescription:
将一个想法转化为专注的产品计划、实用的系统架构和受监督的代理团队。定义首版发布范围、用户旅程、组件、数据流、工具权限、交接流程、审批节点和测试用例。将审核后的成果连接到实施计划或限定范围的Codex交接文档。

五项规划技能搭配一个公开只读的MCP服务器，该服务器展示四种Codelit工作流并获取包含规范集合链接的捆绑Markdown规划模板。无需登录即可使用。该服务器不会访问Codelit账户、接收私有草稿、保存内容、运行独立代理或部署软件。模板是捆绑的参考资料，而非实时账户数据。

payload.name: Chop it
payload.description: 饮食计划器、食谱与美食
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chop It is a UK meal-planning app that does the food admin so you can just cook. Tell it what you fancy, or what’s in the fridge, and it builds your week of dinners from a catalogue of more than 1,000 recipes, then turns them into one sorted shopping list you can send straight to your online basket. The Weekly Diversity Score keeps variety, fibre and plants on the plate without giving up the comfort food you want on a Tuesday night. Plan less, cook more, shop once.
payload.longDescription: Chop It 是一款英国餐食规划应用，帮你处理饮食管理，让你只管烹饪。告诉它你想要什么，或者冰箱里有什么食材，它会从超过1000种食谱的目录中为你规划一周的晚餐，再将这些食谱生成一份整理好的购物清单，直接发送到你的在线购物车。每周多样性评分功能能确保餐盘中既有多样性、膳食纤维和植物性食物，又不会放弃你周二晚上想吃的舒适食品。少计划，多烹饪，一次购物。

payload.name: MeetNotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MeetNotes turns meetings into minutes. Record in the room on your phone, send the MeetNotes Notetaker into a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams call, or capture calls with the desktop app. MeetNotes returns a speaker-labelled transcript plus minutes of meeting — summary, key points, decisions and action items with owners — in 100+ languages, including meetings that switch language mid-sentence.

With this plugin you connect your MeetNotes account and ask about your meetings in plain words: what was decided, who owes what, and where exactly something was said, with links that open the moment in the app. Attach an audio file to have it transcribed, paste a meeting link to send the notetaker, and export minutes as PDF, Word or Markdown. It only sees meetings your account can already see; you approve the connection on a MeetNotes page and can end it from ChatGPT at any time.
payload.longDescription:
MeetNotes将会议转化为会议记录。
可在手机上现场录音，将MeetNotes Notetaker发送至Zoom、Google Meet或Microsoft Teams会议，或通过桌面应用记录通话。
MeetNotes会生成带发言者标签的逐字稿以及会议记录——包含摘要、关键点、决策内容及责任人行动项，支持100多种语言，包括中途切换语言的会议。

通过此插件可连接您的MeetNotes账户，用自然语言询问会议相关内容：哪些决策被通过、谁需要完成什么任务、某句话具体是在什么时间点说的，且链接可直接跳转至应用中的对应时间点。
可上传音频文件进行转写，粘贴会议链接即可发送记录工具，支持将会议记录导出为PDF、Word或Markdown格式。
该插件仅能访问您账户已有的会议记录；您需要在MeetNotes页面批准连接操作，且可随时通过ChatGPT终止连接。

payload.name: AI TeamsMaestro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your meetings contain decisions, commitments, and context that your AI assistant can't access. TeamsMaestro changes that by connecting your entire meeting history to ChatGPT.

The fastest growing AI note taker for Microsoft users, TeamsMaestro joins your calls on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom, automatically capturing everything so nothing gets lost.

Works great for:

- Proposals and docs grounded in what was actually discussed in meetings
- Client call preparation by surfacing everything from past sessions, then going deeper with ChatGPT
- Performance reviews backed by real context and commitments from past conversations
- Missed meeting catch-ups with the ability to ask ChatGPT follow-up questions
- Engineering workflows enriched with project background, requirements, and technical decisions from planning meetings
- Strategic analysis that combines meeting insights with documents and data


Instead of copy-pasting transcripts into ChatGPT and hoping it finds the right detail, TeamsMaestro gives your AI direct access to your meeting history. It pulls exactly what it needs, cites the right conversation, and keeps you focused on the work.
payload.longDescription:
您的会议包含决策、承诺和背景信息，这些是您的AI助手无法访问的。TeamsMaestro通过将您的完整会议历史连接到ChatGPT来改变这一现状。

作为增长最快的Microsoft用户AI笔记工具，TeamsMaestro可接入Microsoft Teams、Google Meet和Zoom会议，自动记录所有内容以防信息丢失。

适用于：

- 基于会议实际讨论内容的提案和文档
- 通过提取过往会话内容进行客户通话准备，再通过ChatGPT深入分析
- 依托过往对话中的真实背景和承诺进行绩效评估
- 错过会议后可通过向ChatGPT提问进行补救
- 通过整合规划会议中的项目背景、需求和技术决策优化工程流程
- 结合会议洞察与文档数据进行战略分析

无需将对话记录复制粘贴到ChatGPT并祈祷它找到正确细节，TeamsMaestro让您AI直接访问会议历史。它会精准提取所需内容，引用正确对话记录，让您专注核心工作。

payload.summaryOriginal: Marcas e o que falta em casa

payload.name: Canva
Everygen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Everygen helps creators generate and edit social-ready videos, images, voiceovers, scripts, ads, and captions directly from ChatGPT. Users can create standalone media or combine scripts, narration, generated scenes, and captions into finished short-form videos.
payload.longDescription: Everygen 帮助创作者直接通过 ChatGPT 生成和编辑适合社交媒体发布的视频、图像、配音、脚本、广告和字幕。用户可以单独创建媒体，也可以将脚本、旁白、生成场景和字幕组合成完整的短视频。

payload.name: Adobe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Adobe 让你在对话中拥有更多创作和完成工作的方式。此前以 Photoshop 提供的 Adobe 连接器，如今涵盖 Creative Cloud 和 Acrobat 的创意与生产力功能。描述你想制作或修改的内容，Adobe 就能帮助将想法、图像、视频和文档变为精美成果——从编辑照片、创建 PDF，到设计社交媒体素材、调整视频尺寸、搜索 Creative Cloud 素材，以及生成数据驱动的文档。
主要功能：

* 精修人像或批量编辑照片：添加照片并描述你想要的效果——调整色彩、光照和色调；移除干扰元素并生成新元素；应用 Lightroom 预设；移除背景；模糊、裁剪、调整尺寸和扩展图像。
* 基于模板设计：从 Express 模板开始，更新文字和颜色，然后为社交媒体添加动画或转换为 PDF。
* 为任何平台优化视频：上传横向视频片段，要求重新排版以适配 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 或任何平台。你还可以将多个片段拼接为一个连续视频。
* 搜索和整理创意作品：描述所需内容，即可按主题、风格、氛围或内容从 Creative Cloud 素材库中找到素材，无需浏览文件夹。
* 处理 PDF 和文档：创建和转换精美的 PDF 和文档。
* 创建数据驱动的文档：描述想要的输出并提供数据——连接器将原始数据或内容转换为排版完善、可分享的 PDF，包括徽章、卡片、目录等。

你可以以访客身份开始使用，也可以登录 Adobe 账户，获得更多功能和工具、Creative Cloud 存储空间，以及跨会话保存的作品。

payload.name: MagicPath
payload.description: 直接在 ChatGPT 中设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MagicPath is an Al design and prototyping tool for creating interactive websites, app interfaces, dashboards, and visual plans on a shared canvas. With the MagicPath plugin, describe what you want to make and turn your ideas, notes, or existing designs into editable work you can explore and refine.

Create a landing page, prototype an app, or design a dashboard with working interactions. Compare multiple Ul and UX design directions, refine layouts and content, and apply reusable themes for a consistent look. Turn meeting notes, product requirements, or a process into flowcharts, wireframes, user journeys, and workshop boards that make the next step easier to understand.

MagicPath supports designers, product managers, founders, marketers, developers, educators, and teams planning how something should look or work. Keep related designs together in team projects and share links for review. In a coding environment with file access, adapt existing React Ul code into MagicPath or export React and TypeScript components to continue implementation in your app.
payload.longDescription:
MagicPath 是一款 AI 设计与原型工具，在共享画布上创建交互式网站、应用界面、仪表板和视觉化计划。通过 MagicPath 插件，描述你想要制作的内容，把想法、笔记或现有设计变成可编辑的作品，供你探索和完善。

创建落地页、制作应用原型，或设计带有可用交互的仪表板。比较多种 UI 和 UX 设计方向，完善布局和内容，并应用可复用主题以保持一致的外观。将会议笔记、产品需求或流程转化为流程图、线框图、用户旅程和工作坊板，让下一步更容易理解。

MagicPath 支持设计师、产品经理、创始人、营销人员、开发者、教育工作者和规划产品外观或行为的团队。将相关设计放在团队项目中并共享链接供审阅。在拥有文件访问权限的编码环境中，可以将现有 React UI 代码调整到 MagicPath，或导出 React 和 TypeScript 组件，继续在应用中实现。

payload.name: Figma
payload.description: 将 Figma 设计付诸代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your Figma designs
payload.longDescription: 使用你的 Figma 设计

payload.name: Riverside
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating videos and podcasts. Once connected, you can edit your recordings, cut clips for social media, publish to all your channels, draft all your episode assets, and find any moment across your recordings. Requires a Riverside account on a Grow plan or above.
payload.longDescription: Riverside 是一个端到端的视频和播客制作平台。连接后，你可以编辑录制内容、剪辑社交媒体短片、发布到所有频道、起草每期节目的全部素材，并在录制内容中查找任意时刻。需要 Riverside Grow 方案或更高等级的账户。

payload.name: OpusClip: Video Editing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OpusClip brings AI video editing into ChatGPT. Turn long videos into short clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, with AI-selected highlights, automatic reframing, and animated captions.
Start with a public or unlisted video link from a supported source, or use videos already uploaded to OpusClip. Edit through conversation: cut unwanted sections, remove filler words and pauses, and customize captions. Your edits are saved to your OpusClip workspace.
Export clips, draft social copy, and request publishing or scheduling to your connected social accounts. You choose the clips, destination accounts, and publishing times.
payload.longDescription:
OpusClip将AI视频编辑功能整合至ChatGPT中。
可通过AI精选亮点、自动裁剪构图和动态字幕功能，将长视频转换为适合TikTok、Instagram Reels和YouTube Shorts的短视频。
可从支持的来源获取公开或未上市视频链接，或使用已上传至OpusClip的视频素材。
通过对话式交互进行编辑：剪辑不需要的片段，移除语气词和停顿，自定义字幕内容。
所有编辑操作都会保存至您的OpusClip工作空间。
可导出短视频素材、撰写社交平台文案，并请求通过已连接的社交账号进行发布或排期。
您可自主选择视频素材、目标发布账号及具体发布时间。

payload.name: NewsTune Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NewsTune Studio helps ChatGPT and Codex inspect existing series, produce private episodes, wait for completion, return direct episode links, compare authorized voices, open secure voice-selection or consented-cloning handoffs, publish approved public pages and RSS feeds, and prepare user-completed distribution to podcast platforms.
payload.longDescription: NewsTune Studio 帮助 ChatGPT 和 Codex 查看现有系列、制作私人单集、等待制作完成并返回单集直达链接、比较获准使用的语音、打开安全的语音选择或经同意的语音克隆交接流程、发布已批准的公开页面和 RSS Feed，并为用户自行完成的播客平台分发做好准备。

payload.name: Sitelas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the website you want. Sitelas builds it — the design, the words, the images, the pages.

It does not stop at launch. It reads the messages your contact form collects, drafts replies, updates your content, and checks which pages people actually read.

Every build lands on a private preview link first. Your real web address stays empty until you say publish. Publishing and connecting your own domain are always yours to do.

Sites live on a sitelas.com address, and you can point your own domain at one when you are ready. A full visual editor is there in the browser whenever you would rather change something by hand.
payload.longDescription:
描述您想要的网站。Sitelas将为您构建——包括设计、文字、图片和页面。

网站上线后仍持续运作。它会读取联系表单收集的信息，起草回复，更新内容，并查看哪些页面真正被读者阅读。

每次构建都会首先生成一个私有预览链接。您的真实网址将保持为空，直到您决定发布。发布和绑定自己的域名始终由您掌控。

网站将托管在sitelas.com的地址下，当您准备就绪时，可以将您的域名指向其中任何一个。每当您希望手动更改内容时，浏览器中都会提供一个完整的可视化编辑器。

payload.name: Higgsfield
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, videos, branded content, and websites with Higgsfield in ChatGPT. Start with an idea, product photo, or reference image, then choose from Viral and Marketing Studio presets, creative recipes, or image and video models. Refine your results through conversation.

With Higgsfield, you can:

• Browse Viral presets with /effects and Marketing Studio presets with /product, /motion, or /marketing-studio. Explore creative recipes and named workflows such as /hero-shot, /reel-cover, and /genjutsu.

• Generate images and videos from text or reference images. Turn a product photo into image ads in different styles, short video ads with different hooks, or a complete set of promotional content.

• Create UGC product videos, reviews, unboxings, tutorials, fashion try-ons, faceless explainers, and episodes with a consistent AI presenter. Write scripts, generate narration, and add subtitles.

• Use Ad Multiplier to create targeted variations of an existing video, or edit footage with animated text, layouts, transitions, motion graphics, and effects.

• Build and deploy websites, web apps, and browser games. Refine the design and update your hosted project through chat.

Connect your Higgsfield account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Higgsfield 创建图像、视频、品牌内容和网站。可从想法、产品照片或参考图开始，选择 Viral、Marketing

Studio 预设、创意配方或图像与视频模型，并通过对话优化结果。

可生成文本或参考图像；将产品照片变成不同风格广告、短视频广告或完整宣传内容；创建

UGC 产品视频、评测、开箱、教程、试穿、无脸讲解和系列节目；编写脚本、生成旁白和字幕；用

Ad Multiplier

制作现有视频的定向变体，或添加动画文字、布局、转场、动态图形和特效；构建并部署网站、Web

应用和浏览器游戏。需要连接 Higgsfield

账户。 详情见上文。

payload.name: Runway
payload.description: 使用所有 AI 模型生成内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Runway lets users generate and edit images, videos, and audio directly from ChatGPT using their Runway account. Users can create images from text or edit an uploaded photo, animate images into video, make targeted edits to existing footage, expand videos to new aspect ratios, build multi-shot story videos and product marketing ads, localize an existing ad into another language, remove backgrounds, upscale media, convert video to HDR, generate music, sound effects, and spoken voiceover, author and run saved Runway workflows, browse recent assets, and check remaining credits and plan. All results are stored privately in the user's connected Runway workspace and rendered inline with a media viewer; purchases are completed on runway.com, never inside the chat.
payload.longDescription: Runway 允许用户通过自己的 Runway 账户，直接在 ChatGPT 中生成和编辑图像、视频与音频。用户可以根据文本创建图像或编辑上传的照片、将图像制作成动画视频、对现有素材进行定向编辑、扩展视频以适配新的宽高比、制作多镜头故事视频和产品营销广告、将现有广告本地化为其他语言、移除背景、提升媒体分辨率、将视频转换为 HDR、生成音乐、音效和语音旁白、创建并运行已保存的 Runway 工作流、浏览近期素材，以及查看剩余点数和套餐。所有结果都会私密保存在用户连接的 Runway 工作区中，并通过媒体查看器内嵌呈现；购买须在 runway.com 完成，绝不会在聊天中进行。

payload.name: invideo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Now anyone can turn any idea into a ready-to-share video using just text prompts. From script to visuals to voiceovers and music, Invideo takes care of all the technical complexities, giving you the freedom to focus on your creative vision. 
Whether you’re an entrepreneur, a business leader, or a storyteller, Invideo is the creative partner that’ll help you push boundaries and bring bold ideas to life — effortlessly and with confidence.
payload.longDescription:
现在任何人只需通过文本提示就能将任何想法转化为可直接分享的视频。
从脚本、视觉效果、配音到背景音乐，Invideo会处理所有技术难题，让你专注于创意愿景。
无论你是创业者、企业领袖还是故事创作者，Invideo都是能帮助你突破界限、自信地将大胆想法付诸实践的创意伙伴。

payload.name: Mobbin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mobbin is the industry standard in UI & UX design references for mobile apps, web apps, and websites. The platform serves millions of product builders and designers across the world to help them design better digital experiences. Connect Mobbin with ChatGPT to better research and explore UI & UX design ideas.
payload.longDescription: Mobbin是移动应用、网页应用和网站的用户界面和用户体验设计参考领域的行业标准。该平台服务于全球数百万的产品构建者和设计师，帮助他们打造更优质的数字体验。将Mobbin与ChatGPT连接，以更高效地研究和探索用户界面和用户体验设计创意。

payload.name: AI Voice Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create natural-sounding voiceovers from any text prompt inside ChatGPT. Provide the transcript, and ChatGPT will automatically generate a high quality, highly realistic voiceover, with access to the full audio recording. Perfect for narration, text-to-speech, and audio books.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 内根据任何文本提示创建自然的配音。提供文稿，ChatGPT 就会自动生成高质量、非常逼真的配音，并提供完整音频录音。非常适合旁白、文本转语音和有声书。

payload.name: OpenArt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create images and video on OpenArt without leaving ChatGPT. Just describe what you want, add reference images if you like, and pick from the latest AI models: Seedance 2.5 / 2.0, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana Pro / 2, Minimax H3 / H3 max, Gemini Omni Flash, Wan 3.0, and more. OpenArt generates it and brings the result back into the chat, updating as it finishes, so you can go from an idea to a finished image or video in a single conversation. No editing tools required. Revisit your past creations anytime, keep your work organized in projects, and check your credit balance as you go. New models appear here automatically as OpenArt adds them.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT内即可创建图像和视频。只需描述你的需求，如需参考图像可添加，然后从最新AI模型中选择：Seedance 2.5 / 2.0、GPT Image 2.5、Nano Banana Pro / 2、Minimax H3 / H3 max、Gemini Omni Flash、Wan 3.0等。OpenArt会生成内容并将其结果带回聊天中，完成时会实时更新，让你在单次对话中即可实现从创意到成品的图像或视频制作。无需任何编辑工具，随时回顾过往作品，通过项目分类保持工作条理，并在使用过程中查看信用额度。当OpenArt新增模型时，这里会自动显示新选项。

payload.name: Visla Video Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Visla Video Maker helps users create narrated videos from scripts drafted in ChatGPT. Users can share a video idea or source materials such as text, documents, PDFs, or URLs, and ChatGPT generates a script from that input. Visla then uses the script to create a narrated video with stock footage and background music. Users can open the generated project on Visla from the ChatGPT conversation to continue editing, export it, or download the final video. A Visla account is required to register and sign in to use these features.
payload.longDescription: Visla Video Maker 可帮助用户根据在 ChatGPT 中起草的脚本制作带旁白的视频。用户可以分享视频创意或文本、文档、PDF、URL 等素材，ChatGPT 会据此生成脚本。随后，Visla 使用脚本搭配素材库视频片段和背景音乐制作带旁白的视频。用户可以从 ChatGPT 对话中打开 Visla 上生成的项目，继续编辑、导出或下载最终视频。使用这些功能需要注册并登录 Visla 账户。

payload.name: Gamma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With Gamma, you can turn your ideas into polished, professional content directly inside ChatGPT. Whether you're drafting a pitch deck, marketing brief, or team update, Gamma helps you create beautiful, on-brand presentations, documents, social posts, and webpages, without leaving your workflow.

You can ask Gamma to:

- "Read this Gamma deck, <link_to_deck>"
- "Turn this technical report into an executive summary."
- "Build a marketing brief for our cybersecurity offering. Adapt it to a non-technical audience."
- "Create a 4-slide pitch deck about a team offsite to Hawaii, add in some jokes."
- "Design a project proposal document with a dark theme." (Themes determine look and feel.)
payload.longDescription:
Gamma 可在 ChatGPT 中把想法转为精致、专业且符合品牌的内容。无论你要起草路演演示文稿、营销简报还是团队更新，Gamma 都能在不离开工作流的情况下创建漂亮的品牌化演示文稿、文档、社交帖子和网页。

你可以让 Gamma：

- “读取这个 Gamma 演示文稿，<link_to_deck>”

payload.name: Picsart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and edit images, videos, audio, and text with Picsart AI models. Compose and render media scenes, inspect model parameters and credit estimates, track generation jobs, and browse, save, and organize files in Picsart Drive.
payload.longDescription: 通过Picsart AI模型创建和编辑图像、视频、音频及文本，创作并渲染媒体场景，检查模型参数和信用预估，跟踪生成任务，并在Picsart Drive中浏览、保存和管理文件。

payload.name: Creative Claw
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create videos, product ads, images and voiceovers in ChatGPT. Animate a photo, turn a script into a multi-scene film, or make a creator-style product ad with narration and captions.

Plan shots and storyboards, prepare consistent reference images, generate clips and assemble a first cut. Turn interviews and longer videos into social clips, cut and reorder selected moments, reframe for vertical formats, and add captions.

Create a reusable avatar from your photos or a fictional character brief. Review its character sheet, save it as a Character, and reuse its visual references in images and videos. Clone your own voice, or a speaker's voice with their explicit permission, from a clean recording. Save and reuse the clone with ElevenLabs or Cartesia, or choose a stock voice for multilingual narration. Generate music and sound effects for the same project.

Generate and edit supporting images, product photos and campaign visuals. Use reference images to guide product appearance, character identity, composition and style. Supported models include Seedance, Gemini Omni, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs and Cartesia; availability and settings vary.

Video Review mode shows the proposed prompt, references, settings and estimated credits before you press Generate. It reviews the request, not a rendered video preview. Auto mode submits the requested generation immediately. Generated storyboards and video drafts can also use credits.

Generation and editing use Creative Claw credits. Request an estimate before generating. Results, character consistency and voice similarity vary. Successfully generated playable videos are charged even when the result does not fully match your expectations. You can inspect balances and recent generation costs, or send feedback to help improve future results. For critical issues, contact support@creativeclaw.co.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中创建视频、产品广告、图像和配音。让照片动起来，将脚本变成多场景影片，或制作带旁白和字幕的创作者风格产品广告。

规划镜头和分镜，准备一致的参考图，生成片段并组装初剪。将采访和长视频变成社交媒体短片，剪切并重新排列选定片段，调整为竖屏格式并添加字幕。

用您的照片或虚构角色简报创建可复用头像。查看角色表，将其保存为角色，并在图像和视频中复用视觉参考。使用清晰录音克隆自己的声音，或在获得说话者明确许可后克隆其声音。使用 ElevenLabs 或 Cartesia 保存并复用克隆声音，也可选择库存声音进行多语言旁白。为同一项目生成音乐和音效。

生成和编辑辅助图像、产品照片及活动视觉素材。使用参考图指导产品外观、角色身份、构图和风格。支持的模型包括 Seedance、Gemini Omni、Nano Banana、ElevenLabs 和 Cartesia；可用性和设置各不相同。

视频审核模式会在您按下生成前显示拟定提示、参考图、设置和预计额度。它审核请求，不提供渲染后的视频预览。自动模式会立即提交请求的生成任务。生成的分镜和视频草稿也可能消耗额度。

生成和编辑使用 Creative Claw 额度。生成前可请求估算。结果、角色一致性和声音相似度会有所不同。成功生成的可播放视频即使未完全符合预期也会收费。您可以查看余额和近期生成成本，或发送反馈帮助改进未来结果。重大问题请联系 support@creativeclaw.co。

payload.name: fal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your creative partner for AI image, video, audio, and 3D generation. Turn ideas into product photos, cinematic clips, social campaigns, voiceovers, and game assets with fal. Start with a prompt or reference image, get help choosing a model, and refine your creations through image editing and conversation.
payload.longDescription: 你的 AI 图像、视频、音频和 3D 创作伙伴。使用 fal 将创意转化为产品照片、电影感片段、社交媒体宣传内容、配音和游戏素材。可从提示词或参考图开始，获取模型选择建议，并通过图像编辑和对话不断完善作品。

payload.name: HeyGen
payload.description: 创建视频、语音与虚拟形象
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HeyGen helps users create and manage AI videos, avatars, voices, translations, templates, brand assets, and related media directly through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: HeyGen帮助用户通过ChatGPT直接创建和管理AI视频、虚拟形象、语音、翻译、模板、品牌资产及相关媒体。

payload.name: Magnific
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ideas into finished visuals with Magnific in ChatGPT. Access every image, audio, video generative models in one place. Run multi-step creative workflows. Upscale to 4K, relight, add voiceovers, build 3D models. Auto-extract layers from any design.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Magnific，将创意变为完整视觉作品。在同一处访问所有图像、音频和视频生成模型，运行多步骤创意工作流。将图像放大至 4K、重新布光、添加配音、构建 3D 模型，并从任意设计中自动提取图层。

payload.name: MyFonts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover fonts by personality, genre, use case, aesthetics, industry — or identify fonts directly from an image. Describe your project, mood, style, creative direction or upload an image in chat and get curated font recommendations that match your intent.

1. Identify font from an image — Upload any image and get the matching fonts in seconds, powered by WhatTheFont.
2. Discover fonts by description — Describe your project's mood, style, industry, or vibe and get curated font recommendations that match.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke MyFonts directly with @MyFonts.
Try prompts like:

payload.name: BlitzReels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BlitzReels helps you turn recordings into short videos. In ChatGPT, you can find existing projects and media, import a video you have permission to use, create captioned clips, edit timelines, generate video assets, and export finished files. Actions use your connected BlitzReels workspace and ask for confirmation before sensitive imports or likeness use.
payload.longDescription: BlitzReels 帮助你将录制内容转为短视频。在 ChatGPT 中，你可以查找现有项目和媒体、导入你有权使用的视频、创建带字幕的片段、编辑时间线、生成视频素材并导出成品文件。操作使用已连接的 BlitzReels 工作区，并会在敏感导入或使用人物肖像前请求确认。
